# Healthcare Cheat Sheet


## Personalizing the Care Experience in 2024


Get the Cheat Sheet


Healthcare in the US is undergoing a revamp. The barriers that have typically divided the health care experience between the doctor’s office, pharmacy and insurance provider are breaking down as big players in the space — including new entrants to the industry like Amazon — acquire current and emerging startups in the vertical.


This era of consolidation promises a new era of personalization of stakeholders in the industry including, HCPs and insurers — which is great news for healthcare and pharma marketers.


In our latest cheat sheet, **Personalizing the Care Experience in 2024: How Data Can Fuel Healthcare Marketers to Reach Audiences in the Moments That Matter** , we examine the evolving healthcare landscape and share how advertisers can leverage a people-based advertising solution to make the most of their campaigns in the coming year.


#### Download Personalizing the Care Experience in 2024


**What Consolidation Means for the Healthcare Industry**


Discover how the industry is evolving and breaking down barriers between patients, healthcare providers and insurance companies.


**Why a Holistic Care Experience is Good News for Marketers**


Explore how healthcare marketers can leverage a more connected health care experience to reach target audiences across the entire care cycle — from the waiting room to the pharmacy.


**How Healthcare Marketers Can Succeed with People-Based Advertising**


Learn how people-based advertising allows marketers to optimize their first-party data, leverage direct partner integrations like PurpleLab and IQVIA to optimize messaging, execute compliance- and brand- safe conscious omnichannel campaigns, plus measure online and offline success from a unified view in a single platform.
